
.desktop-hidden {
    display: none;
}

/* fix for reference highlights */
ol.references li:target, sup.reference:target {
    background-color: var(--qdmodal-background-color);
}

.extiw {
    color: #ffce73;
    text-decoration-color: #ffce73;
}

.extiw-wikipedia {
    color: #88A3E8;
    text-decoration-color: #88A3E8;
}
